title: Scamorza Fritters with Jammy Dipping Sauce
description: Crispy fried scamorza cheese fritters served with a sweet and tangy jammy dipping sauce, inspired by Chinese flavors.
instructions: Combine flour, bake mix, and water in a bowl to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Cut the dough into small pieces and flatten each piece into a disk.
Place a small amount of scamorza cheese in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the cheese and press the edges to seal.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C.
Fry the fritters in batches until golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
Serve the fritters with a jammy dipping sauce.
